The '''Tyras camp''' is a camp formed by [[King Tyras]] and his soldiers, located in a secluded part of the elven forest of [[Isafdar]]. Isafdar and the camp can only be accessed after starting the [[Regicide]] [[Quests|quest]].

==Transportation==
The Tyras camp can be reached in several ways, all of which require partial (or full) completion of [[Regicide]]. Listed here in order from closest to furthest:

* {{plink|Charter ship|pic=War ship}} — Port Tyras, slightly south of the camp (costs {{Coins|3200}}).
* {{Plink|Fairy ring|pic=Fairy ring (Construction) icon}} {{fairycode|BJS}} — island west of the camp (requires 76 [[Agility]] to leave the island).
* {{Plink|Iorwerth camp teleport}} — Iorwerth Camp, north of the Tyras Camp.
* {{Plink|Spirit tree|pic=Spirit tree (Construction) icon}} — Prifddinas, well north of the camp.
* {{Plink|Zul-andra teleport}} — Zul-Andra, south of the camp.
* {{plink|Teleport crystal}} — Lletya, well to the east of the poison waste.

== History ==
{{LoreSources|Regicide|elf tracker|the2=yes|dialogue2=yes|Zul-Aniel|Zul-Areth|dialogue4=yes|dialogue3=yes}}

At some point, [[King Tyras]] made his way through the [[Underground Pass]] and travelled through [[Isafdar]]. While this is not the first camp location his army settled in, it is the final camp location he set up before his death. At some point, two scouts were sent out further south, but were kept from coming back after consuming [[sacred eels]], forcing the scouts to take up at [[Zul-Andra]].

King Tyras was killed by an adventurer who had been tricked by Tyras' brother into believing he was evil. After his death, [[General Hining]] took his place as leader.

== Locations ==
=== Docks ===
{{Main|Port Tyras}}
Players can [[Mooring point|dock]] at Port Tyras with level 66 [[Sailing]]. The southernmost dock offers the following utilities for sailors:

* [[File:Shipwright_map_icon.png|link=Shipwright]] [[Shipwright]]
* [[File:Port_task_board_icon.png|link=Notice_board]] [[Notice board]]
* [[File:Salvaging_station_map_icon.png|link=Salvaging_station]] [[Salvaging station]]
* [[File:Ledger_table_icon.png|link=Ledger_table]] [[Ledger table]]

=== Central camp ===
The camp's [[quartermaster]] runs a [[Quartermaster's Stores|store]] that serves as a [[general store]] but uniquely also sells most types of metal [[Halberd|halberds]], up to [[Dragon equipment|dragon]]. The only exception is the [[white halberd]], which can be purchased from the [[White Knight Armoury]] instead.<!--Please do not add the "missing" crystal or noxious halberds here; this is specifically about METAL halberds.--> Notably, [[Dragon halberd|dragon halberds]] only become available after completing Regicide.

There is also an area north of the camp, featuring a catapult. This catapult is used by players in Regicide.

=== Clearing ===
Eluned teleports between two locations prior to completing Song of the Elves, one of which is the clearing just north-east of the camp. In her place after the quest is an [[Elven Scout|elven scout]] that can also recharge [[Teleport crystal|teleport crystals]], for the same prices.

== Inhabitants ==
=== Personalities ===

* {{Chatl|Tyras guard (Catapult)|text=Catapult guard}}, a distractable guard assigned to the catapult.
* {{Chatl|Eluned}}, a helpful elf who recharges [[teleport crystals]] (found prior to [[Song of the Elves]], and only at certain times).
* {{Chatl|Elven scout|pic=Elven Scout (2) chathead}}, who replaces [[Eluned]] after [[Song of the Elves]] and scouts the area.
* {{Chatl|General Hining}}, the second-in command of King Tyras' army.
* [[King Tyras]], who leads the camp prior to his assassination. He is never seen or interacted with.
* {{Chatl|Quartermaster}}, who manages all trade of the camp.

=== Monsters or attackable NPCs ===
* [[Chicken]] (x3)
* [[Rabbit]] (x11)
* [[Tyras guard]] (x5)
